option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

values.description: Measurements. Non-numeric entries are ignored. Keep them in time order when sigmaMethod is "within".

lsl.description: Lower specification limit. null for none (one-sided specification).

usl.description: Upper specification limit. null for none (one-sided specification).

bins.description: Number of bins, or "auto": Freedman-Diaconis rule (Sturges when the interquartile range is 0), with the bin width rounded to 1, 2 or 5 x 10^k. Bins include their lower edge and exclude their upper edge; the last bin includes both.

showNormalCurve.description: Overlay the normal distribution fitted to the mean and the selected sigma, scaled to the histogram.

showStats.description: Show the readout: n, mean, sigma, the capability indices and the number of values out of spec.

sigmaMethod.description: overall: sample standard deviation of all values; the indices are reported as Pp / Ppk. within: average moving range / 1.128 (short-term variation, as on the SPC chart; needs values in time order); the indices are reported as Cp / Cpk.

decimals.description: Decimal places of the mean and the bin edges (0-10); sigma is shown with one more.

unit.description: Unit of the measurements, shown on the axis, in the readout and in tooltips.

title.description: Chart title. Leave blank for no title.

barColor.description: Colour of the histogram inside the specification limits.

outOfSpecColor.description: Colour of the part of the histogram outside the specification limits.

curveColor.description: Colour of the normal curve and the mean line.

limitColor.description: Colour of the LSL and USL lines.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
